description: Parametric roofline benchmark that sweeps compute-to-memory ratio. Each thread loads one float from global memory, performs a variable-length FMA chain, and stores the result. By varying the FLOP/byte ratio, traces out the roofline curve from memory-bound to compute-bound regimes.

scaling_param.name: buffer_size_mb
scaling_param.description: Array size in MiB; determines total number of elements processed

non_scaling_params.name: flops_per_byte
non_scaling_params.description: Target FLOP/byte ratio; controls the number of FMA operations per thread relative to memory traffic

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
